text: Build job 2 of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md sections 4 and 10, decision D111): the importer. Given a commit C0, it copies every file under records/ at C0 into one commit on the records branch at the same paths, using the writer in athena-git (records_branch) and the ImportManifest record type in athena-data (history.rs), and writes import-manifest.json listing each source path, its blob id at C0 and the SHA-256 of its contents. It then re-reads the new commit and fails if any path, blob or hash differs from C0 or the file counts differ. Tests on a scratch repository: a full import passes its self-check; a missing, changed or extra file fails it; importing twice is refused (records are append-only). Nothing runs it against this repository's main yet and the job pipeline is unchanged.
